# system.css

Vendored build of [sakofchit/system.css](https://github.com/sakofchit/system.css), version 0.1.11.

The files in this directory were produced from the upstream repository with:

```sh
npm ci
npm run build
```

`system.css` is loaded locally by the site. The adjacent fonts and button SVGs are runtime assets referenced by that compiled stylesheet. See `LICENSE` for the upstream MIT license.
